description: Fetches ITP Journal volume/issue data from www.theitp.org, including publication metadata, PDF download links, and page preview images.

function.description:
要调用的功能名。可用值:
  - get_volume: Fetch a specific journal volume by URL or slug; requires url or slug parameter; 参数: url, slug, include_previews; 必填: 无
  - list_volumes: List all available journal volumes; optionally filter by volume number; 参数: volume, include_previews; 必填: 无

url.description: Full URL to a journal volume page (e.g., https://www.theitp.org/publications/the-journal/volume-16-part-4)

slug.description: Storyblok slug for a journal volume (e.g., publications/the-journal/volume-16-part-4)

include_previews.description:
Whether to include PDF preview image URLs in the response
各功能默认值：get_volume=true；list_volumes=false

volume.description: Volume number to filter by when listing volumes (e.g., "16" or "20")
